string.text: My name is Myriel Songseeker, do you know the song?
Me and my family have wandered all over the westlands seeking the song. I dont need to tell you how much suffering we saw, I am sure you have seen your own fair share. My people wandered on
I decided to remain, perhaps if I help those in need I will get closer to finding the song?
So now here I am, sitting in this tavern, contemplating if a verse is found in this time.
I do not know the song? What is one of the Tuatha'an doing here?
I don't know anything about some silly song. Will you join me or not?
If you are offering a chance for me to find my tune, i will offer you all that i have learned in return.
I am determined to write my song to a melody that will age finer than any wine you find in establishments such as these.
